# GriffoWork

> GriffoWork is an AI career intelligence platform: an 8-dimension AI resume audit, ATS-compatibility diagnostics, and job matching for job seekers. Griffo Enterprise is its B2B counterpart, running the same AI resume-to-job compatibility engine for companies hiring externally and moving talent internally.

## GriffoWork (for job seekers)

- [GriffoWork](https://griffo.work): AI-powered resume audit across 8 executive dimensions, ATS optimization, resume rewriting, and career orientation for job seekers, in 12 languages.
- [Hiring](https://griffo.work/hiring): Entry point for candidates who just applied to a job and want to check their resume against it.
- [Free ATS resume check](https://griffo.work/ats-check): Upload a resume and see in seconds how an applicant tracking system reads it. No sign-up required.
- [Country pages](https://griffo.work/global): Localized landing pages for 40+ markets (e.g. [/br](https://griffo.work/br), [/us](https://griffo.work/us), [/de](https://griffo.work/de), [/gb](https://griffo.work/gb)) with local ATS vendors, resume terminology and pricing.

## ATS compatibility guides (one per system)

Each guide explains how the system screens resumes, what breaks parsing, and answers common questions. Available in up to 12 languages via `?lang=` (en, pt, es, de, fr, it, ja, ko, zh, ar, nl, sv).

- [Gupy](https://griffo.work/ats/gupy): Brazil's most used ATS.
- [Solides](https://griffo.work/ats/solides): Brazilian recruiting and screening platform.
- [Workday](https://griffo.work/ats/workday): Enterprise HCM/ATS used by large employers worldwide.
- [Greenhouse](https://griffo.work/ats/greenhouse): Structured-hiring ATS common in tech.
- [Lever](https://griffo.work/ats/lever): ATS/CRM for tech and startup hiring.
- [Taleo](https://griffo.work/ats/taleo): Oracle's legacy enterprise ATS.
- [iCIMS](https://griffo.work/ats/icims): Enterprise talent-acquisition platform.
- [Ashby](https://griffo.work/ats/ashby): All-in-one recruiting platform for growth-stage companies.
- [Personio](https://griffo.work/ats/personio): HR and recruiting software for European SMEs.
- [SmartRecruiters](https://griffo.work/ats/smartrecruiters): Talent acquisition platform for mid-market and enterprise employers.
- [SAP SuccessFactors](https://griffo.work/ats/successfactors): Recruiting module of SAP's HR suite, common in large corporations.
- [Workable](https://griffo.work/ats/workable): Recruiting platform for growing and mid-sized companies.
- [Teamtailor](https://griffo.work/ats/teamtailor): Swedish recruiting platform with branded career sites.
- [InfoJobs](https://griffo.work/ats/infojobs): Spanish job board and applicant system.

## Griffo Enterprise (for recruiting and HR teams)

- [Griffo Enterprise](https://griffo.work/enterprise): AI resume-to-job matching for companies — external recruitment and internal mobility on the same compatibility engine behind GriffoWork.
- [External Recruitment](https://griffo.work/enterprise/external-recruitment): Automatic scoring and ranking of job applicants against a company's own requisitions.
- [Internal Mobility](https://griffo.work/enterprise/internal-mobility): Matching existing employees to new internal openings, using the profile they already maintain on Griffo, with their consent.

## Data

- [Market Pulse](https://griffo.work/market-pulse): Public, CC BY 4.0-licensed hiring-temperature index across tracked countries, aggregated from official sources (BLS, Eurostat, ILOSTAT, CEPALSTAT). Machine-readable at [/api/hiring-index](https://griffo.work/api/hiring-index).
